summary.core_problem: 用户侧 memory 常被当作单一“个性化能力”来评估，但这种聚合指标会掩盖不同记忆机制在风格一致性、事实记住与事实缺失抑制上的相反取舍。
summary.importance: 这是一个带因果探针的机制分析工作。它把 user memory 分解成可分离维度，并比较参数化记忆与检索记忆的能力边界，对理解 RAG、LoRA、长期记忆接口的行为很有参考价值，尤其适合 post-train 与 memory system 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三轴诊断框架：behavioral consistency、factual presence、factual absence。然后在受控 50-user synthetic corpus 和 LaMP-3 上，对比 per-user gamma-LoRA 与 BGE-large top-K dense retrieval。进一步做层级与注意力投影的因果干预，定位 attention 21-35 层 query-projection 单元在两类能力上的相反作用，并通过零化 LoRA 权重验证这种 load-bearing 关系。
summary.experiments: 结果显示 gamma-LoRA 明显优于 RAG 的风格一致性，而 RAG 明显优于 gamma-LoRA 的 factual absence；在 attention 21-35 的 query-projection 上做干预后，absence-probe TPR 可提升 33 个百分点，同时 presence-probe TPR 下降 20 个百分点。摘要未给出底座模型规模，但实验设置相对干净，强调机制分解而非单一总分。

summary_en.core_problem: User-side memory is often evaluated as a single personalization capability, but that aggregate metric hides opposing trade-offs across style consistency, factual recall, and abstention on absent facts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented diagnostic paper with causal probing. It decomposes user memory into separable axes and compares parametric memory against retrieval memory, which is useful for understanding RAG, LoRA, and long-term memory interfaces in post-training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a three-axis diagnostic framework: behavioral consistency, factual presence, and factual absence. It compares per-user gamma-LoRA against BGE-large top-K dense retrieval on a controlled 50-user synthetic corpus and LaMP-3, then performs causal interventions to identify attention-layer query projections (layers 21-35) that load-bear both effects in opposite directions.
summary_en.experiments: Gamma-LoRA strongly outperforms RAG on behavioral style, while RAG strongly outperforms gamma-LoRA on factual absence. Zeroing LoRA weights in query-projection cells from attention layers 21-35 raises absence-probe TPR by 33 points and lowers presence-probe TPR by 20 points. The abstract does not state the base model size, but the setup appears cleaner than typical aggregate personalization evaluations.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent research by Youwang Deng at EpistemicaLab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“记住用户”拆成互相冲突的三个可测维度；若你在做 RAG/adapter memory，先看那组 attention 21-35 的因果干预结果。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it decomposes 'remembering the user' into three conflicting measurable axes; if you work on RAG or adapter memory, start with the causal intervention on attention layers 21-35.

paper.title: PAFO: Pareto Fairness Optimization for Personalized Reward Modeling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on reward models to align their outputs with diverse user preferences. While personalized reward models aim to capture such heterogeneity, they are often trained on imbalanced user preference data and may therefore favor users whose preferences are more common in the training population. In this paper, we identify this failure mode as personalized reward bias, where reward modeling quality varies systematically with preference support rate. We formu

summary.core_problem: 解决个性化奖励模型在不平衡偏好数据上训练时，倾向于多数群体偏好而忽视少数群体偏好的“个性化奖励偏差”问题。
summary.importance: 首次将个性化奖励建模中的偏差问题形式化为帕累托公平优化问题，并提出了一种不牺牲多数群体利益来提升少数群体体验的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PAFO 框架：首先为多数和少数偏好群体分别训练专用的奖励模型，然后构建条件边界级监督（conditional margin-level supervision），将异构的偏好边界蒸馏到一个统一的模型中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体的实验设置和结果数据，但指出该方法旨在提升服务不足用户的体验而不降低其他群体的效用。
summary.authors_note: 字节跳动（Chunyuan Zheng）参与的工作，关注 RLHF 阶段的奖励模型公平性。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing 'personalized reward bias' where personalized reward models trained on imbalanced preference data favor majority preferences and neglect minority ones.
summary_en.importance: First to formulate the bias in personalized reward modeling as a Pareto fairness optimization problem, proposing a framework to improve minority experience without sacrificing the majority.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PAFO framework: first trains group-specialized reward models for majority and minority preference groups, then constructs conditional margin-level supervision to distill their heterogeneous preference boundaries into a single unified model.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks specific experimental setups and results but states the method aims to improve under-served users without degrading other groups' utility.
summary_en.authors_note: Work involving ByteDance (Chunyuan Zheng), focusing on reward model fairness in the RLHF stage.

recommendation.zh: 关注 RLHF 阶段 Reward Model 的群体偏好坍塌问题，提出的 Pareto 蒸馏思路对构建鲁棒的通用 RM 有启发，建议看其蒸馏 loss 的设计。
recommendation.en: Addresses group preference collapse in Reward Models during RLHF; the Pareto distillation approach is insightful for building robust general RMs. Worth checking the distillation loss design.

paper.title: Memory Beyond Recall: A Dual-Process Cognitive Memory System for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory for an LLM agent is more than retrieving the right passage at the right time. Current memory systems collapse belief revision, causal coupling, and cross-domain abstraction into a single retrieval surface tuned for surface recall, and consequently struggle on implicit personalisation that requires reasoning over how a user has evolved. We propose DCPM, which reorganises agent memory along a cognitive capability hierarchy ascending from raw inputs and atomic facts, through diachr

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 长期记忆只做表层检索、难以表示用户信念演化与跨域抽象的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent memory 架构设计，不是基座预训练方法，但对“记忆应否显式建模 belief revision 和 schema induction”这个方向有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DCPM，将记忆组织成分层认知结构：从原始输入、原子事实，到随时间变化的信念轨迹、身份，再到领域 schema、潜在意图和跨域模式。系统分成同步写入的 System1 与异步整理的 System2：前者记录 belief revision 的 supersedes 链，后者做 schema/intent induction，并检测跨域冲突后抽象为更高层 schema。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 LongMemEval、PersonaMem 等长期记忆场景上评测，重点考察隐式个性化和用户演化建模；但从现有信息看，实验更像 agent memory benchmark 上的方法比较，缺少对训练成本、可扩展性和与更强基座模型解耦程度的清晰说明。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the limitation of retrieval-style long-term memory for LLM agents, which cannot represent belief revision, user evolution, and cross-domain abstraction well.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-memory architecture paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it is mildly relevant for thinking about explicit memory structures beyond flat retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DCPM, a hierarchical cognitive memory system spanning raw inputs and atomic facts, diachronic belief trajectories and identity, and higher-level schemas, latent intentions, and cross-domain patterns. It uses a dual-process design: a synchronous System1 writer that records belief revisions via supersedes chains, and an asynchronous System2 engine that induces schemas and intentions and resolves cross-domain collisions into abstract schemas.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluations on LongMemEval and PersonaMem, focusing on implicit personalization and reasoning over user evolution. From the available information, the setup looks like an agent-memory comparison rather than a clean study of scaling, training, or model-intrinsic memory.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory product design，不会直接改变 pretrain 做法；若你在做长期记忆或外部状态建模，只看其 memory hierarchy 和 supersedes chain 设计即可。
recommendation.en: This is closer to agent-memory product design than pretraining research; only skim the memory hierarchy and supersedes-chain idea if you care about externalized long-term state.

paper.title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution
paper.abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on skill libraries to handle complex tasks, making skill evolution a primary driver of self-improvement. However, isolated single-user task streams lack the diversity required to build comprehensive skills. While cross-user collaboration can overcome this data bottleneck, current trajectory-sharing approaches compromise user privacy and impose a uniform global library that fails to accommodate client heterogeneity. We introduce FederatedSkill, a privacy-preser

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 技能演化中单用户轨迹数据不足、直接共享轨迹又损害隐私且难以适配用户异质性的矛盾。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 系统方向里相对有方法味道的一篇，不是简单套壳应用。贡献在于把联邦学习思想引入 agent skill library 演化，并强调个性化而非单一全局技能库。对做 continual learning、post-train 数据闭环的人有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 FederatedSkill。核心不是上传原始轨迹，而是上传 semantic skill diffs，即对本地技能库的结构化 patch。服务端再由 evolution agent 聚合这些 patch，并显式建模不同客户端的 capability boundary，从而做严格个性化的技能演化，而不是求一个全局平均库。这个设计同时处理隐私、通信成本和客户端异质性。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 20 个不同 agent 任务家族上评测，但未给出基座模型、任务环境、对比方法和提升幅度。若实验覆盖跨任务迁移、隐私约束下的性能-通信折中，以及个性化优于全局共享的 clean ablation，这篇会更有说服力；否则容易停留在系统概念验证。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab 与 Cisco Research，机构背景较强。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the tension in agent skill evolution where single-user trajectories are too narrow, but sharing raw trajectories harms privacy and fails to handle heterogeneous users.
summary_en.importance: Within the agent-systems space, this is more method-oriented than a wrapper application. The contribution is to bring a federated-learning style formulation to agent skill-library evolution, with personalization rather than a single global library. It has indirect relevance for continual learning and pretrain↔post-train data loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes FederatedSkill. Instead of uploading raw trajectories, clients communicate semantic skill diffs, i.e., structured patches over local skill libraries. A server-side evolution agent aggregates these patches and models client-specific capability boundaries, enabling strictly personalized skill evolution rather than a global average library. This design jointly addresses privacy, communication cost, and client heterogeneity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the method is evaluated on 20 distinct agent task families, but does not provide the base models, environments, baselines, or effect sizes. The paper will be more convincing if it includes clean ablations on cross-task transfer, privacy-performance-communication tradeoffs, and personalized-vs-global comparisons; otherwise it may remain a systems proof of concept.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab and Cisco Research, both strong institutions for systems and applied foundation-model work.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不直接，但“上传 skill diff 而非轨迹”这个接口设计有味道；只看方法图和个性化 ablation，别在 agent 任务细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretrain paper, but the idea of communicating skill diffs instead of trajectories is a neat interface choice; read the method diagram and personalization ablations, not the task details.

paper.title: Preference-Aware Rubric Learning for Personalized Evaluation
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve from general-purpose assistants to user-centric agents, personalization has become central to aligning model behavior with individual preferences, making the evaluation of personalized alignment a critical bottleneck. Existing evaluation methods-ranging from automatic metrics to LLM-as-a-judge approaches-fail to capture subjective, user-specific preferences embedded in long-term interaction histories. We identify three essential principles for reliable and

summary.core_problem: 个性化对齐越来越依赖长期用户历史，但现有自动指标和 LLM-as-a-judge 难以稳定刻画用户特定偏好，导致 personalized evaluation 不可靠。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测方法而非模型训练。对做对齐、个性化 agent 和 judge 设计的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Personalized Evaluation as Learning，把个性化评测从静态打分改成学习问题；进一步提出 PARL，从原始用户历史中学习 preference-aware rubrics，再据此进行更稳定的个性化评估。论文强调三条原则：Representativeness、User-Consistency、Discriminativeness。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法在 personalized evaluation 上优于传统自动指标和通用 LLM judge，但未给出数据规模、用户数量、评测任务和提升幅度。需要看正文确认 rubric 学习是否真的泛化，而不是对用户历史过拟合。
summary.authors_note: 来自新加坡国立大学、小红书和东京大学。更接近对齐评测与个性化 judge 设计，而不是预训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: As models become more user-centric, personalized alignment depends on long-term user history, but existing automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-judge methods fail to reliably capture user-specific preferences.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation method rather than a training method. It is relevant to alignment, personalized agents, and judge design, but only indirectly useful for foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Personalized Evaluation as Learning, reframing personalized evaluation as a learning problem instead of static scoring. It then introduces PARL, which learns preference-aware rubrics directly from raw user histories and uses them for more stable personalized assessment. The framework is built around representativeness, user-consistency, and discriminativeness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests gains over standard automatic metrics and generic LLM judges for personalized evaluation, but it does not specify dataset size, number of users, task coverage, or effect sizes. The key thing to verify is whether rubric learning generalizes rather than overfitting user histories.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from NUS, Xiaohongshu, and the University of Tokyo. It is best read as alignment-evaluation and personalized-judge work, not a pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做 alignment eval，可以看它怎么把 judge 变成 learned rubric；否则读 abstract 和实验设定就够，离 pretrain 主线较远。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on alignment evaluation: the main idea is turning judging into learned rubrics; otherwise the abstract and setup are enough since it is far from core pretraining.

paper.title: Personalize Your Large Vision-language Models With In-context Prompt Tuning
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong general multimodal capability and are increasingly deployed in downstream systems. This trend has driven growing interest in LVLM personalization, which aims to enable models to quickly and effectively learn out-of-distribution multimodal concepts to meet user-specific needs. However, many existing methods rely on inference-time training, which reduces efficiency. They also struggle to maintain accuracy in complex multi-image, multi-c

summary.core_problem: LVLM个性化：如何在不做推理时训练（test-time training）的前提下，让模型快速学会用户特定的新概念/身份，并支持多图多概念场景。
summary.importance: 属于VLM个性化/轻量适配方法；对“多模态预训练”本身不是直接贡献，但对“如何把少量视觉证据转成可控prompt/条件”有一定可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出In-context Prompt Tuning (ICPT)：用轻量投影模块从多张参考图提取细粒度语义，并结合identity-label映射生成连续prompt；模块自适应决定（摘要截断）以提升计算效率，目标是在推理阶段不做梯度更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体LVLM基座、参数规模、数据集与数值提升；强调在复杂多图多概念设置下优于需要inference-time training的方法。
summary.authors_note: Brown University, Columbia University, University of Alabama at Birmingham, Purdue University, Rutgers University

summary_en.core_problem: Personalizing large vision-language models without inference-time training, especially for multi-image and multi-concept scenarios.
summary_en.importance: A VLM personalization/lightweight adaptation method; not a pretraining contribution, but potentially useful for conditioning/prompt-parameterization design in multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: In-context Prompt Tuning (ICPT): a lightweight projection module extracts fine-grained semantics from multiple reference images and converts them, together with identity-label mappings, into continuous prompts; it adaptively decides (truncated in abstract) to maximize efficiency while avoiding gradient updates at inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits base model(s), scale, datasets, and quantitative deltas; it claims better accuracy in complex multi-image/multi-concept settings than methods requiring inference-time training.
summary_en.authors_note: Brown University, Columbia University, University of Alabama at Birmingham, Purdue University, Rutgers University

recommendation.zh: 当作“把少量视觉样本编译成连续prompt”的工程配方看即可；没看到干净的规模/基座/对齐细节前，不要指望对预训练有硬结论。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a recipe for compiling few visual exemplars into continuous prompts; until the paper shows clean base-model/scale/ablations, don’t expect strong pretraining takeaways.

paper.title: On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is usually treated as a cheaper alternative to full fine-tuning. We study a broader role: small trainable adapters as persistent local state on top of strong shared foundation models. In this framing, the base model provides shared competence while adapters carry instance-specific behavior such as preferences, skills, tool habits, and memory-like updates. We organize the problem around three scaling axes: Scale Up, where stronger shared priors make small lo

summary.core_problem: 研究 PEFT 不只作为低成本微调方案，而是作为强共享基座模型之上的持久个性化状态载体。
summary.importance: 贡献在于重新组织 PEFT 的问题框架：把小 adapter 看作用户偏好、技能、工具习惯和记忆式更新的承载层，重点不在单次微调效果，而在大规模个人模型的管理与服务形态。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕 Scale Up、Scale Down、Scale Out 三个轴分析 PEFT：更强基座如何提高小 adapter 的有效性，adapter 可以缩到多小仍保持可靠，以及大量持久 adapter 如何共存。MinT 被作为基础设施例子，用于管理 adapter 身份、版本、来源、评估和 serving residency。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 或提升幅度，只说明目标场景是 trillion-parameter shared foundation model 上承载 million-level personal adapters。
summary.authors_note: Mind Lab 工作，作者列表包含 Song Cao、Vic Cao、Kaijie Chen 等；摘要未提供可确认的代表性既有工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies PEFT not merely as cheap fine-tuning, but as persistent personalized state on top of a strong shared foundation model.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a framing shift: small adapters are treated as carriers of preferences, skills, tool habits, and memory-like updates, with emphasis on lifecycle management and serving many personalized model instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study is organized around three axes: Scale Up, where stronger shared priors make small local updates more useful; Scale Down, where the minimum reliable adapter size is examined; and Scale Out, where many persistent adapted instances coexist. MinT is presented as an infrastructure example for adapter identity, revision, provenance, evaluation, and serving residency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains, beyond targeting million-scale personal adapters over trillion-parameter shared foundation models.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Mind Lab, with authors including Song Cao, Vic Cao, and Kaijie Chen; no confirmed prior representative work is available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 框架比实验更有用；只看 Scale Out 和 MinT 设计，作为个性化 post-train serving 的问题清单。
recommendation.en: The framing is more useful than the results; read Scale Out and MinT as a checklist for personalized post-training serving.

paper.title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
paper.abstract: If an AI agent makes decisions on a person's behalf, those decisions must align with its user. We introduce representational accuracy to measure how faithfully a system captures a person's interpretation. An interpretive layer is operationalized as a Behavioral Specification. Our reference implementation aggressively compresses a person's data into interpretive patterns, served as context to a language model. We evaluate the Specification on a prototype benchmark of held-out behavioral predictio

summary.core_problem: 个性化 AI agent 代表用户做决策时，如何用更低上下文成本捕捉用户的解释框架和行为偏好，而不只是检索事实记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 和 personalization 表示方法。它提出 representational accuracy 作为个性化系统是否忠实表达用户解释方式的指标，并把 Behavioral Specification 作为可插入的解释层。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把个人数据压缩成 Behavioral Specification，即一组解释性行为模式，并作为上下文提供给语言模型。它不是简单保留原始语料或抽取事实，而是尝试提炼用户如何解释、权衡和行动的模式；并与 raw corpus、extracted facts 以及 Mem0、Letta、Supermemory、Zep 等商业 memory 系统组合比较。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 14 个 public-domain autobiographical corpora，构造 held-out behavioral prediction benchmark，并用校准的 5-judge LLM panel 打分。摘要报告 Behavioral Specification 提升 aggregate representational accuracy，几乎消除模型 hedging，并以约 25x 更少上下文成本恢复 raw corpus 的大部分效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a personalized AI agent can capture a user's interpretive patterns and behavioral preferences at low context cost, rather than merely retrieving facts from memory.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory and personalization representation contribution. It introduces representational accuracy as a measure of whether a system faithfully captures a person's interpretation, and proposes Behavioral Specification as an interpretive layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method compresses a person's data into a Behavioral Specification: a set of interpretive behavioral patterns served as context to a language model. It contrasts this with using the full raw corpus, extracted facts, and commercial memory systems such as Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, and Zep.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use 14 public-domain autobiographical corpora and a prototype held-out behavioral prediction benchmark scored by a calibrated five-judge LLM panel. The abstract reports improved aggregate representational accuracy, near elimination of model hedging, and recovery of most raw-corpus benefits at roughly 25x lower context cost.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 agent memory 压缩方案备查；LLM judge 和自传语料 setup 偏窄，不宜外推到通用个性化。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for agent-memory compression; the LLM-judge and autobiographical-corpus setup is too narrow for broad personalization claims.

paper.title: Personalize-then-Store: Benchmarking and Learning Personalized Memory for Long-horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Existing large language model (LLM) based memory systems apply universal, static policies that overlook a fundamental reality: the contexts that are worth storing in memory are different across users. This misalignment wastes limited memory budget on transient interactions while failing to preserve critical context for long horizon tasks. To address this gap, we investigate an underexplored question: can LLM based memory systems learn personalized memory policies? We introduce PerMemBench, the f

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM agent 记忆系统通常使用统一、静态的存储策略，无法区分不同用户长期任务中真正值得保留的上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 长程记忆 benchmark 和经验分析。它不直接影响基座预训练，但触及长期交互、个性化上下文选择和记忆预算分配，对未来 continual pretrain 或 posttrain memory 数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PerMemBench，用多年、多领域交互历史和多样用户画像评估个性化记忆系统；同时提出 session-level storage gating，在会话级判断是否跳过记忆写入，从而把有限记忆预算留给更长期有用的上下文。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在理想 gating 条件下，个性化策略带来明显 retention gains；但实际准确 gating 仍未解决。摘要未给出具体模型、数据规模、baseline 数字或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM-agent memory systems often use universal and static storage policies, failing to account for which contexts are worth remembering for different users over long horizons.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark and empirical study for long-horizon personalized memory. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-term interaction, personalized context selection, and memory-budget allocation, which may inform continual pretraining or post-training data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PerMemBench, built around multi-year, multi-domain interaction histories and diverse user personas. It also studies session-level storage gating, a lightweight policy that skips memory operations for transient sessions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial retention gains under perfect gating, while showing that accurate real-world gating remains open. It does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, baseline numbers, or exact improvement figures.

recommendation.zh: 个性化 memory 的问题设定比方法更有用；读 benchmark schema 和 gating 误差分析即可。
recommendation.en: The personalized-memory setup is more useful than the method; read the benchmark schema and gating-error analysis.

paper.title: APM: Evaluating Style Personalization in LLMs with Arbitrary Preference Mappings
paper.abstract: Typical LLM responses tend to follow a default style, even though users often have distinct preferences regarding tone, verbosity, and formality that they do not explicitly state in their prompts. Evaluating whether personalization methods can adapt to these implicit preferences is challenging, since users typically provide prompts rather than reference responses, style preferences are not factually verifiable, and reference-free LLM judges may conflate personalization with general response qual

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决隐式风格个性化的评测问题：用户通常只给 prompt，不给参考答案，也不会显式说明自己偏好更正式、更简短或更热情的回答；而 reference-free LLM judge 容易把“写得好”误判为“更个性化”。
summary.importance: 它更像评测方法工作，但对 post-train 数据和 reward 设计有启发。核心点是把主观偏好评测做成可控的随机映射任务，避免 judge 的语义先验和质量偏置污染结论。对预训练研究员而言，价值在于提醒：当目标是风格、偏好、个性化这类不可验证信号时，评测协议必须隔离通用质量、用户语义标签和真实偏好推断，否则模型可能只是在迎合 judge。
summary.technical_approach: APM benchmark 使用隐藏的随机矩阵 C，把用户属性映射到响应原则。例如用户属性可以是 enthusiastic，响应原则可以是 persuasive，但二者关系不按自然语义固定，而是在评测中随机化并隐藏。方法有三个设计。第一，把整体个性化评分拆成窄的 per-principle 判断，每个维度是风格光谱两端，而不是好坏维度，以减少 judge 对通用质量的偏好。第二，让映射条目零均值，使未个性化模型的期望 reward 为 0、win rate 为 50%，残余 judge bias 在期望上抵消。第三，跨评测运行随机化并隐藏映射，让模型不能利用“某类用户通常喜欢某种风格”的先验，只能从历史交互中推断偏好。被评测的方法包括 RAG、prompt optimization 和 routing。RAG 版本用 BGE-M3 检索相似用户，k=3，并基于模拟用户打分构造正负响应对；routing 方法在候选风格或策略之间选择，实验中表现更稳。
summary.experiments: 文中先展示 judge 偏置：在不给真实用户信息、只提示 Qwen-3.5-27B 假装了解用户时，个性化 judge 给出的分数为 1.78，而 generic baseline 为 0.81，说明 judge 会奖励看似贴心或高质量的回答。APM 评测下，未个性化模型期望归零，50% win rate 成为校准基线。对 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的比较显示，routing-based personalization 最稳定地超过非个性化模型，最高 win-loss ratio 达到 1.79。这个结果也说明，仅把相似用户样例塞进上下文不一定能稳定恢复隐藏偏好映射。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造：隐藏随机映射 C、零均值证明、narrow per-principle judge 的设计。然后看附录或实验中关于 judge 偏置的例子，这部分对设计偏好评测很有参考价值。方法部分可快速扫过 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的实现接口；如果只关心评测协议，不必细读每个个性化 baseline 的工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to evaluate implicit style personalization. Users usually provide prompts, not reference responses or explicit style preferences. For tone, verbosity, formality, and similar traits, there is no objective ground truth, and reference-free LLM judges often confuse personalization with general response quality.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to post-training signal design. It shows that subjective preference evaluation can be badly confounded by judge bias and semantic priors about user attributes. For training and evaluating personalized assistants, the useful lesson is that reward protocols need controls that separate generic response quality from actual inference of a user-specific preference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Arbitrary Preference Mapping benchmark hides a randomized mapping C from user attributes to response principles. A user attribute such as being enthusiastic does not deterministically imply a natural style preference; the mapping is sampled and hidden. The benchmark uses narrow per-principle judgments rather than a single holistic personalization score, so each judge decision concerns one stylistic axis instead of overall quality. The mapping is constructed with zero-mean entries, which makes an unpersonalized model have expected reward zero and a 50% win rate. Because the mapping is randomized across runs, semantic priors about which users should like which styles provide no signal. The evaluated personalization methods include retrieval-based generation, prompt optimization, and routing. The RAG variant retrieves similar users with BGE-M3 using k=3 and constructs contrastive positive and negative responses from simulated user scores.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports a simple but useful bias check: when Qwen-3.5-27B is prompted to act as if it knows the user, without actual user information, a personalization judge scores it 1.78 versus 0.81 for a generic baseline on a 1–10 scale. This indicates that the judge rewards generic cues of personalization. Under APM, the non-personalized baseline is calibrated to zero expected reward and 50% win rate. Among the tested methods, routing-based personalization most reliably beats the non-personalized baseline, with a reported win-loss ratio up to 1.79. Retrieval and prompt-optimization variants are less stable, suggesting that recovering a hidden preference mapping from conversation history is harder than injecting superficially relevant examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is sufficient. Read the benchmark design first: the hidden randomized mapping, the zero-mean calibration argument, and the narrow per-principle judge setup. The judge-bias experiment is worth checking because it makes the evaluation failure concrete. The personalization baselines can be read more lightly unless the goal is to implement a comparable benchmark or reproduce the routing setup.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计比方法更有料：随机隐藏映射能有效卡住“刻板关联+judge 偏好”的投机路径；只需看任务构造与 judge 分析部分。
recommendation.en: More interesting as an eval design than a method: the re-sampled hidden mapping blocks stereotype/judge shortcuts; focus on the task construction and judge-confound analysis.

institutions: Technical University of Munich, Helmholtz Munich

paper.title: Tiny-Engram: Trigger-Indexed Concept Tables for Generative Vision
paper.abstract: Current personalization methods for generative vision models typically encode new concepts through continuous adapters or weight updates, yet provide limited control over whether and when a concept should be retrieved. In this work, we introduce Tiny-Engram, a compact trigger-indexed concept table that gives visual memories an explicit lexical address and activation boundary inside frozen image and video generators. Tiny-Engram parameterizes each concept as a small set of memory entries indexed

summary.core_problem: 解决生成式视觉个性化中，新概念通常通过连续 adapter 或权重更新写入模型，但缺少显式“何时触发、何时不触发”的检索边界。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成中的参数高效个性化与可控记忆注入。对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值不在图像生成本身，而在“触发词索引的外部概念表”这一记忆寻址设计，和离散检索式知识注入有类比空间。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tiny-Engram：在冻结的图像/视频生成器外接一个小型 trigger-indexed concept table。每个概念由少量 memory entries 表示，通过注册的 n-gram 匹配触发，只在匹配到的 trigger span 内调制 text encoder hidden states；未触发时条件路径与原模型完全一致。该设计可用于 latent diffusion 和多编码器 diffusion-transformer。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在单编码器 latent diffusion 与多编码器 DiT 骨干上都验证了方法，能把稀有触发短语绑定到目标身份，同时保留周围 prompt 的组合控制；还把同一表式记忆评估到文本条件视频生成。未给出具体数据集、参数量和数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of explicit retrieval boundaries in personalized generative vision, where new concepts are usually injected through continuous adapters or weight updates without clear control over when they should activate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits in parameter-efficient personalization and controllable memory injection for multimodal generation. For a pretraining researcher, the value is not image generation per se, but the idea of a trigger-indexed external concept table, which resembles discrete retrieval-style knowledge injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tiny-Engram attaches a small trigger-indexed concept table to frozen image/video generators. Each concept is represented by a few memory entries activated by registered n-gram matches, and these entries modulate text-encoder hidden states only within the matched trigger span; outside that span, the conditioning path is identical to the frozen base model. The method is applied to both latent diffusion and multi-encoder diffusion-transformer backbones.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims validation on both single-encoder latent diffusion and multi-encoder DiT backbones, showing that a rare trigger phrase can be bound to a target identity while preserving compositional control from the surrounding prompt. The same table-based memory is also evaluated in text-conditioned video generation. No concrete datasets, model sizes, or gains are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“只在触发 span 注入记忆、其余路径保持 frozen-identical”这个设计很干净；做外部记忆/概念绑定的人可借鉴，其他人看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'inject memory only on the trigger span while keeping the rest frozen-identical' design is clean; useful if you care about external memory or concept binding, otherwise the abstract is enough.

paper.title: Spectral Souping: A Unified Framework for Online Preference Alignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) effectively aligns Large Language Models (LLMs) with aggregate human preferences but often fails to address the diverse and conflicting needs of individual users. To overcome this issue, we introduce Spectral Souping, a unified framework for efficient, online preference alignment. Our contribution is the discovery of a universal spectral representation within LLMs, which is proven to be highly amenable to model merging. This theoretical insight e

summary.core_problem: 标准 RLHF 或 DPO 通常把多人的反馈压成一个聚合偏好模型，难以处理用户之间相互冲突的偏好。为每个用户单独微调又太贵。该工作要解决的是在线个性化对齐：在不为每个用户重新训练完整模型的条件下，如何用少量偏好维度组合出接近用户定制策略的 LLM。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏 post-train，但对预训练研究也有信息增益。它把偏好对齐写成 language MDP 下的最大熵 RL 问题，并指出最优策略的 logits 可以看作 reference logits 加上偏好诱导的 Q-function。这个视角把“偏好方向”放到 logit/Q 函数空间里讨论，给模型合并、adapter 合并、个性化 reward conditioning 提供了更清楚的结构假设。它的实际价值不在于替代通用对齐，而在于把一组离线训练好的偏好基策略变成在线可组合的模块。对预训练侧的启发是：如果偏好、风格、能力可以在低维谱空间中近似线性组合，那么基座模型的表示和 logits 空间可能存在可利用的可组合结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从带 KL 正则的最大熵 RLHF 形式出发。状态是已经生成的 token 序列，动作是下一个 token，转移是确定性的拼接。最优策略满足 soft Bellman backup，并可写成 reference policy 的 logits 加上最优 Q-value 的形式。随后把个性化偏好建模成多目标 MDP：每个基础 reward r_k 对应一个偏好维度，用户偏好是权重向量 w 对这些 reward 的线性组合。核心假设和理论结果是，不同个性化策略的 logits 并非散落在任意空间，而是落在由 MDP 谱特征定义的低维结构中；因此可以用少量 basis logit functions 表示。训练流程分两阶段。离线阶段训练若干专门策略，每个策略对齐一个细粒度偏好维度。在线阶段根据用户偏好权重动态“soup”这些策略，可以在输出/logit 层合并，也可以做参数合并。理论部分给出相对于完全为该用户微调的 tailored policy 的次优界，条件是谱近似误差和合并误差受控。
summary.experiments: 实验部分针对在线偏好对齐 benchmark，比较 spectral souping、单一聚合对齐模型、为用户单独适配的策略以及更直接的策略/模型合并方法。可用内容只给出了定性结论：该方法在在线个性化场景中能接近完全定制策略，同时避免每个用户单独微调的成本；并支持 output merging 和 parameter merging 两种实现路径。材料中没有给出具体模型规模、偏好维度数、数据集名称、胜率或 reward 分数，因此不能补写精确数值。实验最需要核查的是：用户偏好是否真能由线性 reward 权重描述，basis policy 数量增加时收益是否饱和，以及参数合并是否在较大模型上仍稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论建模和算法部分。先看 language MDP 与 soft RLHF 公式，确认最优 logits 与 Q-value 的关系；再看多目标 reward 和用户权重向量的假设；最后看 spectral representation 的定理条件、次优界里哪些项来自谱近似，哪些项来自合并误差。实验部分重点看在线用户偏好如何产生或估计、basis policy 如何训练、output merging 与 parameter merging 的代价差异。值得深挖的问题是：偏好维度是否需要正交，basis policy 之间的干扰如何度量，logit-space souping 与 LoRA/adapter-space merging 在大模型上是否有不同稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: Aggregate RLHF and DPO optimize a single preference model, which is often a poor fit for users with conflicting goals. Fine-tuning a separate LLM for every user is too expensive. The work studies online personalized alignment: how to approximate a user-tailored policy by combining a small set of pretrained preference-specialized policies at inference time.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it gives a structured view of preference directions in logit space. By formulating language generation as a KL-regularized maximum-entropy MDP, the optimal aligned policy can be written as reference logits plus a preference-induced Q-function. This makes policy merging less ad hoc: specialized policies become basis functions in a low-dimensional spectral space. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is the possibility that style, preference, and behavior directions may be approximately compositional in the model’s logit or value-function space. That has implications for modular alignment, preference-conditioned pretraining, and the interface between base models and post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts from a soft RLHF formulation. The state is the generated prefix, the action is the next token, and the transition is deterministic concatenation. With a KL penalty to a reference model, the optimal policy satisfies a soft Bellman equation and its logits can be expressed as the reference logits plus an optimal Q-value term. Personalized alignment is then cast as a multi-objective MDP. Each base reward r_k represents a preference dimension, and a user is represented by a simplex weight vector w, giving a combined reward r_w = Σ_k w_k r_k. The central theoretical claim is that the logits of personalized policies admit a shared spectral representation: they can be approximated by a linear combination of a small number of basis logit functions. This leads to a two-stage algorithm. Offline, train specialized policies for fine-grained preference dimensions. Online, infer or receive the user preference weights and combine the basis policies, either through output/logit merging or parameter merging. The theory provides sub-optimality bounds relative to a fully tailored policy under controlled spectral approximation and merging error.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target online preference-alignment benchmarks and compare spectral souping with aggregate alignment, per-user tailored adaptation, and simpler merging baselines. The available material reports the qualitative outcome: the method can approach the behavior of a fully user-tailored policy while avoiding per-user fine-tuning, and it supports both output-level and parameter-level merging. Exact model sizes, datasets, number of preference dimensions, win rates, reward scores, and ablation values are not present in the provided content, so they should not be reconstructed. The empirical claims that deserve the closest inspection are whether user preferences are well captured by linear reward mixtures, how performance scales with the number of basis policies, and whether parameter merging remains stable for larger LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the theory and algorithm sections closely. The key steps are the language-MDP formulation, the soft Bellman derivation connecting optimal logits to Q-values, the multi-objective reward assumption, and the spectral representation theorem. In the bound, separate the approximation error of the spectral basis from the error introduced by policy merging. In the experiments, focus on how user weights are obtained, how the specialized basis policies are trained, and how output merging differs from parameter merging in cost and stability. Useful follow-up questions include whether preference dimensions need to be independent, how interference among basis policies is measured, and how this compares with LoRA or adapter merging at larger scale.

recommendation.zh: 只看 spectral basis 的定义和在线 souping 实验；若大模型参数合并也稳，会改写个性化 RLHF 必须重训的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the spectral-basis definition and online souping experiments; if parameter merging holds at scale, it weakens the default assumption that personalized RLHF needs retraining.

paper.title: CPC-VAR:Continual Personalized and Compositional Generation in Visual Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have recently emerged as an efficient paradigm for text-to-image generation. Despite their strong generative capability, existing VAR-based personalization methods remain limited to static settings, failing to accommodate evolving user demands. In particular, sequential concept learning leads to severe catastrophic forgetting, while multi-concept synthesis often suffers from feature entanglement and attribute inconsistency. In this work, we present the first sy

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉自回归图像生成模型在个性化定制中无法持续学习新概念、且多概念组合容易遗忘和属性缠绕的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 continual personalization 明确放到 VAR 图像生成框架中系统研究。它不是基座预训练工作，但对理解视觉 AR 模型的可编辑性、概念存储位置和灾难性遗忘有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一框架，核心包括 Gradient-based Concept Neuron Selection，用梯度信号识别与概念相关的神经元，并只约束冲突神经元以减少顺序学习时的干扰；同时处理多概念组合生成中的特征缠绕和属性一致性问题。摘要显示这是在现有 VAR 个性化方法上的机制化改进，而不是重新训练基础生成模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VAR backbone、参数量、训练数据、baseline 名称或定量提升。实验应围绕连续单概念学习、多概念组合、遗忘程度和生成一致性评估展开。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括哈尔滨工业大学、清华大学深圳国际研究生院、清华大学、鹏城实验室和华南理工大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses continual personalization in visual autoregressive image generators, where sequential concept learning causes forgetting and multi-concept generation leads to entanglement and attribute inconsistency.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic treatment of continual personalized generation for VAR models. It is not a foundation pretraining paper, but it may be useful for understanding editability, concept localization, and interference in autoregressive visual generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework includes Gradient-based Concept Neuron Selection, which uses gradient signals to identify concept-relevant neurons and constrains only conflicting neurons during sequential customization. It also introduces mechanisms for controllable composition of multiple personalized concepts. The method appears to adapt existing VAR personalization rather than train a new base generator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the VAR backbone, parameter count, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation covers continual single-concept learning, multi-concept composition, forgetting, and attribute consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include Harbin Institute of Technology, Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University, Peng Cheng Laboratory, and South China University of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和遗忘 ablation 即可；它更像 VAR 个性化编辑，不会改变对视觉 AR 预训练的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and forgetting ablations; this is VAR personalization/editing, not a result that changes visual AR pretraining priors.

paper.title: Thinking Ahead: Prospection-Guided Retrieval of Memory with Language Models
paper.abstract: Long-horizon personalization requires dialogue assistants to retrieve user-specific facts from extended interaction histories. In practice, many relevant facts often have low semanticsimilarity to the query under dense retrieval. Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG systems are still largely retrospective: they rely on embedding similarity to the query or on fixed graph traversals, so they often miss facts that matter for the user's needs but lie far from the query in embed

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG、GraphRAG等检索系统均为回溯式设计，依赖查询与记忆的嵌入相似度或预构建的图遍历规则，无法召回与查询语义相似度低但对用户未来需求至关重要的潜在记忆，成为长周期个性化交互的核心瓶颈。
summary.importance: 打破了传统检索范式中存储结构与检索策略的强耦合，首次将认知科学中的前瞻模拟机制引入大模型记忆检索，为长周期智能体记忆系统设计提供了全新范式；配套的MemoryQuest基准填补了长周期跨域潜在记忆检索评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出前瞻引导检索（PGR），是独立于底层存储介质的检索策略，可与向量库、实体图、事件日志等任意存储结构兼容。核心为迭代的模拟-检索-优化循环：收到用户查询后，先用思维树或线性链模拟多个未来可能的任务轨迹，每个模拟步骤触发对应相关记忆的召回，再用召回的记忆修正模拟轨迹，直到覆盖所有潜在需求。与现有方法的核心区别是完全脱离存储结构限制，无需预构建索引或边关系，通过实时前瞻推理挖掘记忆间的潜在关联。
summary.experiments: 构建了MemoryQuest多会话基准，包含时间线一致、跨域分布、与查询语义相似度低的3~5条关联记忆的查询任务，专门针对回溯式检索的瓶颈。在1500+查询、3个基准上的实验显示，PGR的检索召回率和响应质量显著优于标准RAG、GraphRAG等基线，人工评测与大模型评测的结果对齐度高。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第1章引言中的前瞻机制原理和检索解耦核心逻辑、第2章的PGR迭代循环设计、第4章的MemoryQuest基准构造规则、第5章的消融实验（对比不同模拟策略、不同存储介质下的性能差异）。值得深挖的方向包括前瞻模拟的token开销优化、与预训练阶段记忆能力的结合方式、降低推理延迟适配实时交互的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval systems including standard RAG and GraphRAG follow a retrospective paradigm, relying on embedding similarity between queries and memories or pre-defined graph traversal rules. They fail to retrieve latent memories with low semantic similarity to the query but critical for users' future needs, which forms a core bottleneck for long-horizon personalized interactions.
summary_en.importance: PGR breaks the tight coupling between storage structure and retrieval strategy in traditional retrieval paradigms. It introduces the prospection mechanism from cognitive science into LLM memory retrieval for the first time, providing a new paradigm for long-horizon agent memory system design. The accompanying MemoryQuest benchmark fills the gap in evaluating cross-domain latent memory retrieval for long-term interactions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prospection-Guided Retrieval (PGR) is a retrieval policy independent of underlying storage media, compatible with vector stores, entity graphs, and episodic logs. Its core is an iterative Simulate-Retrieve-Refine loop: after receiving a user query, it first simulates multiple possible future task trajectories via Tree-of-Thought or linear chains, triggers retrieval of relevant memories at each simulated step, then revises the simulation trajectory with retrieved memories until all potential needs are covered. Unlike existing methods, it does not rely on pre-built indexes or edge relations, and mines latent associations between memories via real-time prospective reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The MemoryQuest multi-session benchmark is constructed, with queries that require retrieving 3~5 cross-domain associated memories with low semantic similarity to the query and consistent chronological dependencies, targeting the bottleneck of retrospective retrieval. Experiments on over 1500 queries across 3 benchmarks show that PGR significantly outperforms baselines including standard RAG and GraphRAG on retrieval recall and response quality. Results from human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge are highly aligned.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the prospection mechanism and core logic of retrieval decoupling in Chapter 1, the design of the PGR iterative loop in Chapter 2, the construction rules of the MemoryQuest benchmark in Chapter 4, and ablation experiments in Chapter 5 (comparing performance under different simulation strategies and storage media). Points worth further exploration include token overhead optimization for prospective simulation, integration with memory capabilities during pre-training, and reduction of inference latency for real-time interaction scenarios.

recommendation.zh: MSR 的 RAG 记忆检索小方法；只看 ToT probe 构造和失败案例，别把它当长期记忆范式改写。
recommendation.en: A compact MSR memory-retrieval idea; read the ToT-probe construction and failure cases, but do not overread it as a new long-term-memory paradigm.

paper.title: EgoPro-Bench: Benchmarking Personalized Proactive Interaction in Egocentric Video Streams
paper.abstract: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain primarily reactive, failing to continuously perceive environments or proactively assist users. While emerging benchmarks address proactivity, they are largely confined to alert scenarios, neglect personalized context, and fail to evaluate the precise timing of human-machine interactions (HMI).In this paper, we introduce EgoPro-Bench, a novel benchmark for training and evaluating proactive interaction capabilities based on streaming egocent

summary.core_problem: 评测 MLLM 在第一视角视频流中，能否结合个性化用户上下文，在合适时间主动发起交互，而不是只被动回答问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 benchmark 和评测协议。它把 proactive MLLM 评测从简单告警扩展到个性化意图、流式视频和交互时机，对未来 wearable / always-on assistant 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EgoPro-Bench，基于 streaming egocentric videos 构造训练和评测数据；用模拟用户画像生成多样化用户意图，并跨 12 个领域构造 HMI 数据；同时定义面向主动交互的评测协议和指标，并训练低延迟流式推理模型作为基线。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 2,400 个评测视频和超过 12,000 个训练视频。摘要未给出具体 backbone、参数量和数值结果，但说明进行了全面评测，并覆盖主动交互时机、个性化上下文和流式视频处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether MLLMs can proactively interact with users at the right time in egocentric video streams while using personalized user context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal benchmark and evaluation protocol. It moves proactive MLLM evaluation beyond alert-only settings toward personalized intentions, streaming perception, and timing-sensitive human-machine interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: EgoPro-Bench builds training and evaluation data from streaming egocentric videos. It uses simulated user profiles to generate diverse intentions, constructs HMI data across 12 domains, defines specialized metrics, and trains low-latency streaming proactive interaction models as baselines.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 2,400 evaluation videos and more than 12,000 training videos. The abstract does not report backbone details, model sizes, or numerical results, but indicates broad evaluation over timing, personalization, and streaming-video reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 这是 MLLM 产品形态 benchmark，不是预训练方法；看数据构造和 timing metric，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is a product-shape MLLM benchmark, not a pretraining paper; inspect the data construction and timing metrics, then move on.

summary_en.core_problem: OpenAI officially releases GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default model for ChatGPT, aiming to provide a smarter, more accurate, less hallucinatory, and more personalized experience.
summary_en.importance: Major industry news. The release of GPT-5.5 Instant marks OpenAI's next-generation iteration in model capabilities (especially accuracy and hallucination control), directly impacting the baseline of the entire LLM ecosystem.

paper.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong implicit personalization ability, yet most existing approaches treat this behavior as a black box, relying on prompt engineering or fine tuning on user data. In this work, we adopt a mechanistic interpretability perspective and hypothesize the existence of a sparse set of Preference Heads, attention heads that encode user specific stylistic and topical preferences and exert a causal influence on generation. We introduce Differential Preference Steering

summary.core_problem: 解释并利用 LLM 的“隐式个性化”能力：模型如何在不微调的情况下根据用户历史/画像呈现不同风格与偏好？作者提出一个可检验的机制假设：个性化主要由少量稀疏的注意力头（Preference Heads）承载，并且这些头对生成有可观测的因果影响。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限（更偏机制分析 + 解码期干预），但对两类研究有启发：
1) 机制层面：把“个性化/风格”从黑盒行为拆成可定位的电路组件，提供了可复用的因果发现范式（head-level causal masking + 贡献度量）。
2) post-train 接口：给出一种 training-free 的个性化路径，可能减少为每个用户做 LoRA/微调的需求；同时也提示在对齐/偏好建模时，模型内部可能存在可分离的偏好通路，值得在训练中显式正则或约束。

从筛选角度，它不是预训练方法论文，但属于“机制分析/可控生成”里相对有结构的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
两步：发现 + 利用。

(1) Preference Heads 发现：
- 用因果 masking 分析对每个 attention head 做干预（屏蔽/移除该 head 的输出），观察对“用户对齐生成”的影响。
- 定义 Preference Contribution Score (PCS)：度量某个 head 对偏好对齐程度的因果贡献（论文表述为直接测量 head 对 user-aligned generation 的 causal impact）。核心是把‘相关性’变成‘可干预的贡献’，避免仅凭激活强度或注意力模式做归因。

(2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS) 解码期个性化：
- 在解码时对比“启用 Preference Heads”与“抑制 Preference Heads”两种预测分布，取差分信号并放大，用来提升偏好一致的续写、压制更通用/中性的续写。
- 进一步做 cluster-aware steering：考虑用户异质性，让相似用户共享部分偏好电路（减少每个用户单独找 head 的成本，并提升稳定性）。

与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 这类对比解码的区别在于：DPS 的对比对象不是层/检索头等预定义结构，而是通过因果分析定位到的“个性化相关头”。
summary.experiments:
模型：LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct、Qwen2-7B-Instruct。
数据与任务：LaMP 个性化基准，覆盖生成（headline、scholarly title、tweet paraphrase 等）与预测类任务（分类/回归，如 citation identification、movie tagging、product rating）。
指标：生成用 ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR；分类用 Acc/F1；回归用 MAE/RMSE。
对比基线：CAD、DoLa、DeCoRe（均为解码期干预/对比类方法）。

从全文描述的结论层面：DPS 在多个开源指令模型与多类 LaMP 任务上提升个性化一致性/风格对齐，同时保持内容连贯与计算效率；并通过“mask 掉这些 heads 会破坏个性化行为”来支持其因果性主张。具体提升幅度需要结合论文实验表格逐项查看（摘要未给出统一的绝对数字）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 先读方法部分 PCS 的定义与 head masking 的实现细节：干预发生在什么位置（head 输出/attention weights/OV 投影之后）、如何避免与 dropout/kv-cache 等实现细节混淆、PCS 的统计是否跨样本/跨用户聚合。
- 再读 DPS 的解码公式：差分分布如何与原 logits 合成、放大系数如何选、是否引入温度/归一化以避免退化。
- 实验部分重点看：
  - 与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 的对比表（不同任务类型是否一致受益）；
  - “mask preference heads 会破坏个性化”的因果验证；
  - cluster-aware 版本是否显著减少 per-user 搜索成本。
- 预计不需要逐字精读数据集介绍；把时间留给消融与可视化（head 分布、激活模式与风格维度的对应）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLM personalization mechanistically interpretable and controllable: instead of treating user-specific style/topic adaptation as a black box, it hypothesizes that a sparse set of attention heads (“Preference Heads”) causally mediates personalized generation.
summary_en.importance: It is closer to mechanistic interpretability plus decoding-time control than pretraining. Still, it matters to foundation-model researchers in two ways: (1) it offers a reusable causal-discovery recipe at the head level (masking + contribution scoring) for isolating circuits behind high-level behaviors; (2) it suggests a training-free personalization path that could reduce per-user fine-tuning, and hints that preference/alignment signals may flow through partially separable internal pathways—useful when thinking about how post-training interfaces with the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two stages: identify and steer.

1) Identifying Preference Heads:
- Perform causal masking interventions on individual attention heads (ablate/mask a head) and measure the impact on user-aligned outputs.
- Define a Preference Contribution Score (PCS) to quantify each head’s causal contribution to preference-aligned generation, aiming to move from correlational attribution to intervention-based evidence.

2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS):
- At decoding time, contrast the model’s token distribution with Preference Heads enabled vs. suppressed, then amplify the differential signal to promote preference-consistent continuations and suppress generic ones.
- Extend to cluster-aware steering so users with similar profiles can share partially overlapping preference circuits, reducing per-user overhead.

Compared with CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe, DPS’s contrast set is not a fixed structural choice (layers, retrieval heads) but a causally discovered subset tied to personalization.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen2-7B-Instruct.
Benchmark: LaMP, covering both user-conditioned generation tasks and prediction tasks (classification/regression).
Metrics: ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR for generation; Accuracy/F1 for classification; MAE/RMSE for regression.
Baselines: CAD, DoLa, DeCoRe.

Reported outcomes: DPS improves personalization fidelity/style alignment across models and tasks while maintaining coherence and efficiency; masking the identified heads disrupts personalized behavior, supporting the causal claim. Exact deltas are table-dependent and should be read directly from the main results tables (the provided excerpt does not include consolidated numbers).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Read the PCS definition and the exact masking intervention: where the ablation is applied (head output vs. attention weights), how scores are aggregated across users/examples, and how they control for confounds.
- Read the DPS decoding equation carefully: how the differential distribution is combined with base logits, how the steering strength is chosen, and what normalization/temperature is used to avoid degeneration.
- In experiments, focus on: (a) head-to-head comparisons vs. CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe across task types, (b) causal validation via masking, (c) cluster-aware steering’s cost/benefit.
- Spend less time on dataset boilerplate; prioritize ablations and interpretability visualizations (which heads, which layers, and how activations map to style/topic dimensions).

recommendation.zh: 如果你做机制分析，这篇值得看 head-level 因果识别是否真有稀疏性；若只是做 pretrain，可只读 PCS 定义和 ablation，别把“功能定位”过早当成稳定事实。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the head-level causal identification if you do mech interp; if you are mainly a pretraining person, just inspect the PCS definition and ablations, and do not over-trust functional localization too early.

paper.title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
paper.abstract: Personalized agents that interact with users over long periods must maintain persistent memory across sessions and update it as circumstances change. However, existing benchmarks predominantly frame long-term memory evaluation as fact retrieval from past conversations, providing limited insight into agents' ability to consolidate memory over time or handle frequent knowledge updates. We introduce Memora, a long-term memory benchmark spanning weeks to months long user conversations. The benchmark

summary.core_problem: 现有个性化 agent 的长期记忆评测大多只测“能否找回旧事实”，却很少测“能否忘掉过时记忆并整合更新后的用户信息”。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark 与 metric：把长期记忆从单纯 recall 扩展到 consolidation、reasoning 和 forgetting。对做 memory agent、长期对话系统、甚至 continual pretrain 评测设计的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Memora，一个跨数周到数月用户对话的长期记忆 benchmark，覆盖 remembering、reasoning、recommending 三类任务；同时提出 Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy (FAMA)，在评估时惩罚模型依赖已失效或被更新的旧记忆。方法重点不在新 agent 架构，而在更贴近真实使用场景的评测协议。
summary.experiments: 评测了 4 个 LLM 和 6 个 memory agents。摘要结论是：模型经常重复使用无效记忆，且难以协调随时间变化的记忆；memory agents 只带来边际提升。摘要未给出具体模型名、对话规模和数值幅度，但 benchmark 设计本身比结果更值得看。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Arizona State University 与 University of Arizona。Chitta Baral 在知识表示、推理与 agent 方向有长期积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing benchmarks for personalized agents mostly test fact recall from past conversations, but rarely evaluate whether agents can forget obsolete memories and reconcile updated user information over time.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark and metric: it expands long-term memory evaluation from simple recall to consolidation, reasoning, and forgetting. This is useful for memory agents, long-horizon dialogue systems, and even evaluation design for continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Memora, a benchmark spanning weeks-to-months user conversations, with tasks for remembering, reasoning, and recommending. It also proposes Forgetting-Aware Memory Accuracy (FAMA), which penalizes reliance on outdated or invalidated memories. The novelty is in the evaluation protocol rather than a new agent architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates four LLMs and six memory agents. The headline finding is that models frequently reuse invalid memories and struggle to reconcile evolving memories, while memory agents provide only marginal gains. The abstract does not provide model names, dataset scale, or exact margins, so the benchmark design matters more than the leaderboard.
summary_en.authors_note: From Arizona State University and the University of Arizona. Chitta Baral is well known for work in knowledge representation, reasoning, and agent-related research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 FAMA 这个指标值得借去看 continual memory；正文只需读 benchmark 设定和错误类型，别太在意榜单。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but FAMA is worth borrowing for continual-memory evaluation; read the benchmark design and failure taxonomy, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: New ways to create personalized images in the Gemini app
paper.abstract: Example images made with Personal Intelligence

summary.core_problem: 这不是论文，也不是预训练方法研究。内容讨论的是 Gemini app 如何调用用户 Google Photos 和个人偏好做个性化图像生成，核心是产品侧的个性化检索、上下文接入和隐私声明，而不是基座模型训练、统一建模目标或 post-training 方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究几乎没有直接信息增益。它没有提供模型结构、训练目标、数据配比、对齐方法、评测设计或可复现的技术细节。唯一勉强相关的点，是展示了一种“私有上下文不进训练、只在推理时接入”的产品路径，这对 personal memory / retrieval-augmented generation 的系统设计有一点参考，但不构成研究贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 从全文能确认的技术内容很有限：Gemini 通过 Personal Intelligence 读取已连接 Google 应用中的兴趣偏好，并可从 Google Photos 中自动选择参考图像，交给 Nano Banana 2 做图像生成；用户可以查看来源、替换参考图、继续迭代；官方强调不会直接用私人照片库训练模型。这里看起来更像是检索增强的个性化生成产品，而不是新的生成模型训练范式。没有公开说明 reference selection、identity preservation、隐私隔离、个性化表示注入、或图像生成 backbone 的关键实现。
summary.experiments: 没有实验。没有离线 benchmark、没有用户研究设计、没有 A/B 指标、没有失败案例统计，也没有任何关于模型规模、训练数据、推理成本或安全评估的定量结果。因此无法按研究论文标准分析其有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 不建议作为研究论文阅读。若只是想了解产品方向，读完全文即可，5 分钟内足够。重点只需看三处：Personal Intelligence 如何接入个人上下文、Google Photos 如何作为参考源、以及隐私声明中“不会直接用私人照片训练模型”的边界。若目标是预训练、post-training 或多模态统一建模研究，可以直接跳过。
summary.authors_note: Google AI Blog，产品公告，未提供可确认的论文作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: This is not a research paper and does not study pretraining. It describes a Gemini app feature that uses Google Photos and user preferences to generate personalized images. The core issue is product-side personalization through private-context retrieval and user controls, not model training, unified multimodal objectives, or post-training methodology.
summary_en.importance: It offers almost no direct value for foundation-model pretraining research. There is no disclosure of architecture, training objective, data mixture, alignment method, evaluation protocol, or reproducible technical detail. The only mildly relevant point is the product pattern of keeping private user data out of model training and injecting it only at inference time, which is loosely relevant to personal memory and retrieval-augmented generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical content disclosed in the blog is minimal. Gemini uses Personal Intelligence to access connected-app preferences and can automatically select reference images from Google Photos, then uses Nano Banana 2 to generate personalized images. Users can inspect sources, swap reference photos, and refine outputs iteratively. Google explicitly states that private photo libraries are not used to directly train the model. This looks like a retrieval-augmented personalization pipeline rather than a new training paradigm. The blog does not explain reference selection, identity preservation, privacy isolation, personalization embeddings, or the underlying image-generation backbone in any meaningful detail.
summary_en.experiments: There are no experiments. No benchmark, no user-study methodology, no A/B metrics, no quantitative safety analysis, and no numbers on model scale, training data, or inference cost. So there is nothing to evaluate under normal research standards.
summary_en.reading_guide: Not recommended as a research read. If the goal is simply to understand the product direction, the whole piece can be read in under five minutes. The only parts worth noting are how Personal Intelligence injects user context, how Google Photos is used as a reference source, and the privacy boundary that private photos are not directly used for model training. If your focus is pretraining, post-training, or multimodal foundation-model research, this can be skipped.
summary_en.authors_note: Google AI Blog product announcement; no clearly attributable paper-style author list is provided.

recommendation.zh: 只是图像生成功能更新；除非你在跟踪产品落地节奏，否则对统一多模态预训练没有研究价值。
recommendation.en: Just a product update for image generation; unless you track deployment cadence, it adds nothing to multimodal pretraining research.

paper.title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs

summary.core_problem: 基准分数难以反映真实可用性时，如何理解并形式化用户常用的“vibe-testing”（基于个人工作流的非正式模型对比评估），使其可系统化与可复现。
summary.importance: 评测方法学贡献：把用户个性化的测试内容与主观判据显式建模，提出可操作的评测流水线雏形；对“离线benchmark→真实使用体验”的鸿沟提供结构化视角，但对预训练本身间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 基于两类经验资源（用户调研 + 社媒/博客的模型对比报告）归纳vibe-testing流程，并形式化为两部分个性化：个性化prompt生成 + 用户感知的主观评价准则；实现一个proof-of-concept pipeline，用用户感知标准比较模型输出。
summary.experiments: 包含对调研与“野外”对比报告的分析，并在若干任务上演示个性化评测流水线（摘要截断，未给出明确基准、模型集合与量化提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: When benchmark scores fail to capture real usefulness, how to understand and formalize users’ informal “vibe-testing” of LLMs so it becomes systematic and reproducible.
summary_en.importance: Evaluation methodology contribution: explicitly models personalization in both what users test and how they judge outputs, offering a structured view of the benchmark–real-world gap; indirectly relevant to pretraining via better evaluation signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes two empirical sources (a survey of user practices and in-the-wild comparison reports) and formalizes vibe-testing as personalized prompt generation plus user-aware subjective criteria; proposes a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline following this formulation.
summary_en.experiments: Includes analyses of survey and online reports and a demonstration pipeline; the abstract is truncated and does not provide detailed model/task sets or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但能改你对评测的 prior：只看他们如何把 vibe-test 任务与判据结构化成可复现流水线，适合拿来改内部模型选型流程。

paper.title: Through Their Eyes: Fixation-aligned Tuning for Personalized User Emulation

summary.core_problem: 如何让用于推荐系统评测的“用户模拟”型VLM/LLM agent不再只看文本/结构化特征，而是对齐真实用户在UI布局上的个性化注视（gaze）模式，从而提升点击行为模拟的真实性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏“多模态对齐 + 机制/可解释性驱动的个性化适配”：指出推荐界面中的视觉注意力具有强个体稳定性且能预测点击；提出将VLM内部注意力与人类注视对齐的个性化调参思路，为“用VLM做用户仿真/评测”提供更接近真实交互界面的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FixATE：先用可解释性/归因算子探测VLM内部视觉注意力，得到可与人类fixation对比的slot-level相关性分布；再进行“注视对齐”的个性化学习/调参，使模型注意力分布贴近特定用户的gaze模式，并用于更高保真度的用户点击/偏好模拟（面向carousel式推荐布局）。
summary.experiments: 基于真实眼动数据集（carousel推荐场景）做分析：展示个体注视模式稳定且对点击强预测；对比未对齐/仅文本或元数据感知的模拟器与FixATE在用户仿真保真度上的差异。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、具体指标与提升幅度。

institutions: Singapore University of Technology and Design

summary_en.core_problem: How to make VLM/LLM-based user simulators for recommender-system evaluation attend to UI layouts in a way that matches an individual user’s gaze patterns, improving the realism of simulated clicks and preferences.
summary_en.importance: Highlights that visual attention on recommendation UIs is individually stable and predictive of clicks, and proposes a personalization mechanism that aligns model attention with human fixations, offering a more faithful path for VLM-based user emulation and interpretability in interactive recommendation settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FixATE: first extracts interpretable, slot-level internal visual attention/attribution maps from a VLM that are comparable to human fixation distributions; then performs fixation-aligned personalization so the model’s attention matches a specific user’s gaze, enabling higher-fidelity click/preference simulation in carousel-style layouts.
summary_en.experiments: Uses a real eye-tracking dataset in a carousel recommendation scenario to show gaze stability and click predictiveness, and compares FixATE against non-aligned or text/metadata-only simulators for user-emulation fidelity; the abstract does not report model sizes, metrics, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 作为“用户仿真评测”文献备查即可：gaze对齐很直观但数据与场景强绑定，难迁移到通用预训练；看方法图和主要指标表就够。
recommendation.en: Mostly a literature bookmark for user-emulation evals: gaze alignment is intuitive but heavily dataset/UI-specific, so not much for general pretraining; just scan the method figure and main table.
